name: ksp1-flight
prompt: Create an approval-quality UI concept render for an existing Kerbal Space Program companion telemetry display, KSPKontroller. This is a NEW THEME, not a screenshot of the game and not the Apollo/Steampunk skins. Perfect front-facing flat screen mockup, entire app screen visible, no device, no perspective, no desk, no giant promotional title or explanatory callouts. Landscape 3:2 composition designed for a 2520x1680 Raspberry Pi display. High-fidelity production-feasible SDL2 interface, crisp readable typography, consistent spacing and functional scientific instruments. English UI text. Preserve the app's content: thin top mission/status header; upper-left two rows of five metric cells (ALTITUDE 81.5 km; ORBIT SPEED 2397 m/s; APOAPSIS 250 km; PERIAPSIS 80 km; VERTICAL +50 m/s; SURF SPEED 2222 m/s; INCLINATION 2.5 deg; ECCENTRICITY 0.111; PERIOD 37m 17s; SEMI-MAJOR 765 km). Left lower column: vessel resource bars (ELECTRIC CHARGE, LIQUID FUEL, OXIDIZER, MONOPROPELLANT), altitude/speed history plot, four-row staging table. Right upper row: ORBIT (detailed full-colour Duna globe, orbital ellipse with Ap/Pe marks and a white vessel ring) and VESSEL (simple read-only rocket side schematic with fuel fill). Right lower: dominant large spherical NavBall, heading/speed/pitch/roll/throttle and burn readouts around it, SAS/RCS and mode buttons at bottom. NavBall blue sky, warm brown ground, white authentic spherical degree markings, yellow fixed boresight and standard navigation symbols. Maintain realistic panel density; no useless tiny decorative text, false features or 3D scenery. The visual language must strongly resemble the supplied game UI references, redesigned as a dedicated telemetry console. THEME: KSP1 STOCK. Faithfully echo original KSP 1.x stock UI: charcoal backgrounds and grey moulded plastic window frames with restrained metallic bevels, thin raised borders, compact slightly condensed humanist sans headings, familiar lime-green LCD values on dark grey insets, small toggle-like SAS/RCS controls with green active state, neutral grey inactive tabs, restrained teal-blue category highlights. Include a modest original-game-style mechanical ALTITUDE odometer strip integrated at the top (not competing with telemetry), stock silver/graphite NavBall instrument housing with green speed window, throttle and G-force arc gauges alongside the sphere, compact grey physical-looking stage capsules. Familiar practical late-2000s game UI, not brushed-white Apollo metal, not steampunk, not glossy science fiction. Minor hardware depth, tactile game controls; clean mature visual hierarchy. Header title KSP KONTROLLER / STOCK, vessel ARES ORBITER, small LIVE lamp.

name: ksp1-flight-v2
prompt:
Edit this UI proposal while preserving its complete visual identity, exact panel composition, materials, fonts, NavBall style and overall high quality. This is a targeted correction to show ONLY information the existing telemetry app supports. Keep all the rest unchanged.
1) ALTITUDE / SPEED HISTORY is a read-only 180-second history: remove time-range choice buttons if present and use caption LAST 180 s; axis labels -180 s, -120 s, -60 s, NOW. Retain the plot, no other navigation or controls.
2) STAGING is read-only, exactly four columns: STAGE, PARTS, DELTA-V (m/s), STATUS; four rows 02 | 7 | 1430 | ACTIVE, 01 | 4 | 820 | PENDING, 00 | 2 | 0 | PENDING, -- | -- | -- | --. Remove ISP, TWR, burn, fuel and remaining-time columns from this flight staging panel. Keep the table's size and style.
3) Around the NavBall retain heading, speed, pitch, roll and throttle; replace any TWR window with G-FORCE 0.30 g. Burn / node delta-v and time readouts are supported, keep them.
4) VESSEL must be a simple white/grey side-silhouette rocket schematic with green tank fills, with FUEL / HEAT mode labels. Remove faux photographic/3D vehicle render and detailed unprovided total-mass/delta-v claims in this small panel. Keep its outer bounds and title.
5) Keep resources and the detailed full-colour Duna orbit view. No added game viewport, no new features. English text. This is a polished approval render, not a schematic annotation.

name: ksp1-scenes
prompt:
Generate a polished DESIGN APPROVAL BOARD for the same KSPKontroller theme shown in the supplied flight proposal. Use that proposal as the governing visual identity: match its fonts, materials, window frames, header/tab treatment, data hierarchy, active and disabled controls exactly. New image, flat front-facing screen concepts, no device, no perspective. Landscape 3:2 board, quiet neutral background, six clearly separated miniature COMPLETE app screens arranged three columns by two rows. Each screen has a small external caption above it; screen text should be short and legible, avoid paragraphs. The six captions and contents:
1 LINK / NO VESSEL: top app identity and connection status; central detailed globe inside theme-native search scope; WAITING FOR GAME and secondary NO VESSEL state, concise connection detail. A link-search illustration, not live orbit data.
2 FACILITIES: Space Center / MISSION OPERATIONS header, three numbered read-only preparation cards BUILD / PLAN / PREPARE with short lines VAB / SPACEPLANE HANGAR, MISSION CONTROL, ASTRONAUT COMPLEX. This same treatment covers all eight facilities.
3 VAB / CONSTRUCTION: actual ship summary, four top figures TOTAL DELTA-V, MISSION DELTA-V, TARGET, MARGIN; stage list at left; destination matrix and vehicle mass/parts/seats data at right. Read-only summary, NOT a 3D assembly viewport, no part picker and no launch button.
4 VAB / ACTIONS: four small metric cards then ACTION GROUPS / ASSIGNMENTS list left, SELECTED IN KSP detail right; show selected CUSTOM 1 in theme's active style. No invented controls.
5 VAB / CREW: ASSIGNED 1, CAPACITY 3, FREE SEATS 2, PILOTS 1 metrics; SEAT MANIFEST list left with Valentina Kerman and two EMPTY rows; CREW COMPLEMENT right. Data lists rather than unprovided character portraits.
6 VAB / CARGO: ITEMS 3, MASS 22 kg, VOLUME 84 L, INVENTORIES 1; STORED PARTS list left (REPAIR KIT, EVA CYLINDER), INVENTORY CAPACITY right with compact capacity bar.
Every view uses the exact same theme, polished production-ready information design, consistent active/inactive/amber-warning/red-error colours. These are app-only interface mockups, no huge new branding, no 3D game scenes. Keep them recognizably distinct from Apollo and Steampunk. Short board heading above all screens: KSP1 STOCK. Match this theme's supplied flight reference faithfully.

name: ksp1-scenes-v2
prompt:
Targeted correction of this six-screen KSPKontroller theme proposal board. Preserve ALL visual styling, materials, layout, six-panel arrangement, fonts, grey Stock frames and cyan/green accents exactly. Correct the scope of controls outside flight:
- EVERY miniature screen is outside flight. Remove the flight altitude odometer / atmosphere meter from ALL six headers. Replace that same header region with a neutral context tag: LINK SEARCH, SPACE CENTER, VAB CONSTRUCTION, VAB ACTIONS, VAB CREW, VAB CARGO respectively. No flight altitude or speed values on these screens.
- Remove the entire bottom RCS / SAS / ORBIT / SURFACE / TARGET / MANEUVER control row from ALL SIX screens. On screen 1 replace with a plain connection-status footer RECONNECTING / NO FLIGHT DATA. On screens 3-6 replace with a restrained editor-mode strip BUILD | ACTIONS | CREW | CARGO, highlighting only the matching mode. These are context indicators, not flight controls.

- Preserve the four remaining panel families' correct information, destination list, figures and compact tables. Preserve the whole board's premium KSP1-stock visual language. No other new controls, no annotations, no changed theme, no game scenery. This edit is to make the proposal faithfully applicable to our app's NON-FLIGHT scenes.

name: redux-scenes-v2
prompt:
Targeted edit of this six-screen KSPKontroller KSP2 Redux approval board. Preserve the six-panel layout and ALL visual identity: navy cards, blue-violet title bars, angular technical type, bright green selections, cyan details and restrained yellow accents. Correct content to the actual app:
1) In LINK / NO VESSEL, replace every green CONNECTED label with amber SEARCHING. Endpoint must read GAME PC : 50003, never port 8085. Keep WAITING FOR GAME, NO VESSEL and the illustrated search globe; those are unavailable-telemetry states.
2) FACILITIES screen must show the actual SPACE CENTER / MISSION OPERATIONS checklist, exactly THREE large read-only rows: 01 BUILD / VAB / SPACEPLANE HANGAR; 02 PLAN / MISSION CONTROL; 03 PREPARE / ASTRONAUT COMPLEX. Remove the invented launch/training facility list and its READY action-looking buttons. Footer SCENE CONTEXT LIVE.
3) VAB / ACTIONS top four metric cards must read GROUPS 17, ASSIGNED 1, ACTIONS 1, FLIGHT INPUTS 2. Remove the unrelated delta-v/TWR/burn/mass figures from that screen only. Retain ACTION GROUPS / ASSIGNMENTS and SELECTED IN KSP lists.
4) All four VAB screens must have the correct local context strip BUILD | ACTIONS | CREW | CARGO, highlighting the corresponding mode: BUILD in construction, ACTIONS in actions, CREW in crew, CARGO in cargo. Replace the current general LINK/VESSEL/VAB/FACILITIES navigation row in these four panels with that editor-mode strip. These are scene indicators rather than invented game launch controls.
5) Keep the construction, crew and inventory panels readable and consistent. The KSP2 REDUX label denotes this skin, not a forced game backend. No flight SAS/RCS/speed controls outside flight, no game viewport or launch button, no new scenes or extra features.
Maintain a finished polished visual proposal, not annotated corrections.
